description: Create your pledge in an open pool. Returns a deposit_address: send the pool's stake_amount of its mint plus the small SOL reserve there, then call signet_pledge_confirm before the pool locks. One pledge per account per pool. Until the pool locks you can withdraw everything; after it locks your stake stays until the organiser burns or releases it, or the deadline passes. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

memo.description: Optional public note, max 200 characters. For a sealed contest entry: the sha256 fingerprint of your answer.

payout_address.description: The Solana address a prize should be sent to if you win. Public.

name: signet_pledge
